status: planned—not a published or implemented count

features.name: wordCount
features.description: Content word counters using locale segmentation.
features.gap: Angular has no word counter.

features.name: truncateWords
features.description: Article previews cut at word boundaries.
features.gap: Grapheme truncation does not preserve whole words.

features.name: wrapWords
features.description: Plain-text messages wrap to grapheme-bounded lines.
features.gap: Angular does not wrap generated text.

features.name: readingTime
features.description: Localized article reading estimates.
features.gap: Duration formatting does not estimate time from content.

features.name: normalizeWhitespace
features.description: Clean pasted labels without stripping markup.
features.gap: Angular casing/slice do not normalize whitespace.

features.name: stripDiacritics
features.description: Latin accent folding for search labels; preserve other scripts.
features.gap: Slugify additionally removes punctuation and changes case.

features.name: excerpt
features.description: Show a grapheme-safe context window around a literal match.
features.gap: TruncateMiddle does not locate query context.

features.name: highlightMatches
features.description: Structured literal search highlights, never HTML.
features.gap: Angular has no match-to-segments pipe.

features.name: humanizeIdentifier
features.description: Readable acronym-aware API/schema labels.
features.gap: Legacy camel title splitting splits capitals, lacks acronym boundaries.

features.name: escapeRegExp
features.description: Turn a search term into literal regex pattern text.
features.gap: Angular provides no literal regex escaping.

features.name: graphemeCount
features.description: User-visible character limits for multilingual fields.
features.gap: String length and SlicePipe count UTF-16 code units.

features.name: splitLines
features.description: Render pasted multiline content as readonly input rows.
features.gap: Angular has no line splitting pipe.

features.name: chunk
features.description: Group cards into fixed-size display rows.
features.gap: SlicePipe cannot create a nested grid.

features.name: flatten
features.description: Present nested lists with explicit bounded depth.
features.gap: Angular does not flatten arrays.

features.name: compact
features.description: Drop nullish values while retaining 0 and false.
features.gap: Angular has no nullish-only array compaction.

features.name: partition
features.description: Split records into matching and remaining buckets.
features.gap: groupBy creates arbitrary groups rather than a two-way predicate partition.

features.name: zip
features.description: Pair parallel data series to the shorter length.
features.gap: Angular has no pairwise zip.

features.name: unzip
features.description: Split paired coordinates into parallel series.
features.gap: Zip is pairing, unzip is projection of paired input.

features.name: slidingWindow
features.description: Create overlapping chart/history windows.
features.gap: Chunk gives disjoint groups, not overlapping windows.

features.name: pluck
features.description: Project own direct properties from record lists.
features.gap: Angular has no typed list projection.

features.name: filterBy
features.description: Display records with an own property equal to a value.
features.gap: Existing removeByKey excludes matches; this selects matches.

features.name: intersectionBy
features.description: Show records shared between selections by identity key.
features.gap: Angular has no keyed set intersection.

features.name: differenceBy
features.description: Show unselected records by identity key.
features.gap: removeByKey compares primitive exclusions, not another record collection.

features.name: unionBy
features.description: Combine record sets with first-record precedence.
features.gap: uniqueBy handles one array, not keyed multi-source union.

features.name: symmetricDifferenceBy
features.description: Show records exclusive to either selection.
features.gap: Distinct set operation, not an alias of union/intersection.

features.name: indexBy
features.description: Build a prototype-safe lookup Map from records.
features.gap: groupBy retains multiple records; this indexes last record per key.

features.name: countBy
features.description: Summarize category frequencies without retaining grouped arrays.
features.gap: groupBy returns full groups, not counts.

features.name: mergeBy
features.description: Reconcile partial records with shallow last-field precedence.
features.gap: Union retains one entire record rather than merging fields.

features.name: paginate
features.description: Generate page items and total-page metadata for client display.
features.gap: SlicePipe returns only a slice, without pagination metadata.

features.name: getPath
features.description: Read an own-property path supplied as a key array.
features.gap: Angular does not traverse dynamic paths; no expression evaluator.

features.name: pick
features.description: Display explicitly allowed own fields.
features.gap: KeyValuePipe enumerates rather than selecting fields.

features.name: omit
features.description: Create a display object excluding named own fields.
features.gap: Pick is an allowlist, omit an exclusion list.

features.name: renameKeys
features.description: Remap schema field names without silently losing collisions.
features.gap: Angular provides no safe field-key remapping.

features.name: defaults
features.description: Fill only nullish own fields from shallow defaults.
features.gap: Object spreading overwrites present values.

features.name: invertRecord
features.description: Invert scalar mappings while preserving duplicate-value keys.
features.gap: KeyValuePipe does not invert mappings or preserve reverse collisions.

features.name: pruneEmpty
features.description: Remove recursively empty data while preserving zero and false.
features.gap: Omit requires named fields; this prunes by documented emptiness.

features.name: pathEntries
features.description: Flatten own leaf values to key-array paths, without dotted-key ambiguity.
features.gap: KeyValuePipe only enumerates one level.

features.name: sumBy
features.description: Sum finite numeric fields for dashboard totals.
features.gap: Angular formats numbers but does not aggregate records.

features.name: averageBy
features.description: Mean numeric fields for dashboard summaries.
features.gap: Formatting does not compute a mean.

features.name: minBy
features.description: Find the original record with the smallest numeric field.
features.gap: Sorting a whole array allocates more and obscures the record-selection contract.

features.name: maxBy
features.description: Find the original record with the largest numeric field.
features.gap: Distinct extremum selection, stable first tie.

features.name: summarizeBy
features.description: One-pass count/sum/mean/min/max summary.
features.gap: Composite dashboard summary, not a median/percentile alias.

features.name: percentileBy
features.description: Interpolated percentile for numeric dashboard samples.
features.gap: Angular has no percentile calculation.

features.name: weightedAverageBy
features.description: Weighted average with explicit nonnegative weights.
features.gap: A simple mean ignores record weights.

features.name: extentBy
features.description: Numeric lower/upper bounds for chart domains.
features.gap: Returns bounds without returning records or sorting.

features.name: cumulativeSum
features.description: Running totals for chart series.
features.gap: SumBy returns one total, not prefix sums.

features.name: movingAverage
features.description: Full-window averages for chart smoothing.
features.gap: SlidingWindow creates arrays, not numeric smoothing.

features.name: histogram
features.description: Bounded equal-width bins for numeric distributions.
features.gap: Grouping by an existing key cannot bucket continuous values.

features.name: percentageChange
features.description: Signed percentage change from a nonzero baseline.
features.gap: PercentPipe formats a ratio but does not compute change.

features.name: clamp
features.description: Constrain numeric display values to explicit bounds.
features.gap: Angular provides no bounds operation.

features.name: roundTo
features.description: Numeric decimal-place rounding with signed precision.
features.gap: Legacy roundHalf is a fixed two-decimal display behavior.

features.name: roundToStep
features.description: Round to increments and optional origin.
features.gap: Decimal places cannot express quarter-unit or custom increments.

features.name: ratio
features.description: Compute a finite quotient with an explicit nonzero divisor.
features.gap: Angular number formatting is not safe quotient calculation.

features.name: pluralCategory
features.description: Expose Intl cardinal/ordinal category for custom presentation.
features.gap: I18nPluralPipe maps categories to supplied strings rather than exposing the category.

features.name: formatFraction
features.description: Approximate finite values as localized bounded-denominator fractions.
features.gap: Number formatting does not produce rational numerator/denominator text.

features.name: basisPoints
features.description: Display decimal ratios as basis points, without financial advice.
features.gap: PercentPipe displays percent, not basis points.

features.name: numberBase
features.description: Display safe integers or bigint in bases 2–36.
features.gap: DecimalPipe does not format binary/hexadecimal integers.

features.name: dateParts
features.description: Structured Intl calendar fields for segmented date UI.
features.gap: DatePipe returns one formatted string rather than structured parts.

features.name: calendarDayDifference
features.description: Signed difference of UTC calendar dates, not 24-hour durations.
features.gap: RelativeTime describes a point relative to a clock, not calendar-day differences.

features.name: isWithinInterval
features.description: Inclusive timestamp interval membership.
features.gap: Angular has no date interval predicate.

features.name: overlapDuration
features.description: Milliseconds shared by two half-open timestamp intervals.
features.gap: DateRange formats endpoints but does not compute overlap.

features.name: isoWeek
features.description: UTC ISO week-year and week number for reporting.
features.gap: DatePipe does not expose a typed ISO reporting period.

features.name: quarter
features.description: UTC quarter number for fiscal/calendar labels.
features.gap: Angular has no quarter calculation.

features.name: unixTimestamp
features.description: Floor epoch seconds, including pre-1970 values.
features.gap: DatePipe formats dates rather than returning Unix seconds.

features.name: dateBucket
features.description: UTC start-of-day/week/month/quarter/year for chart grouping.
features.gap: Date formatting does not normalize period boundaries.

features.name: businessDaysDifference
features.description: Signed UTC Mon–Fri day counts with caller-supplied holidays.
features.gap: No built-in business-calendar counting or hidden holiday data.

features.name: dateSequence
features.description: Bounded inclusive UTC date sequences for calendars.
features.gap: Angular does not generate date sequences.
